name: svg-french-press-ember-1-s2-r2
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="520" height="860" viewBox="0 0 520 860" font-family="sans-serif">
  <rect width="520" height="860" fill="#fafafa"/>
  <text x="260" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" font-weight="bold">French Press — Exploded Assembly</text>

  <!-- Knob -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="260" cy="75" r="22" fill="#444"/>
    <circle cx="253" cy="68" r="5" fill="#777"/>
    <text x="330" y="80" font-size="13" fill="#333">knob</text>
    <line x1="305" y1="76" x2="322" y2="78" stroke="#888" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Lid -->
  <g>
    <path d="M178 150 a82 34 0 0 1 164 0 z" fill="#777"/>
    <rect x="172" y="150" width="176" height="12" rx="4" fill="#555"/>
    <ellipse cx="260" cy="150" rx="88" ry="8" fill="none" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="260" cy="146" rx="14" ry="4" fill="#444"/>
    <text x="370" y="150" font-size="13" fill="#333">lid</text>
    <line x1="348" y1="152" x2="364" y2="150" stroke="#888" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Rod -->
  <g>
    <rect x="254" y="97" width="12" height="520" fill="#999"/>
    <rect x="256" y="97" width="3" height="520" fill="#ccc"/>
    <text x="150" y="340" font-size="13" fill="#333">plunger rod</text>
    <line x1="252" y1="336" x2="230" y2="336" stroke="#888" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Spiral spring (three-piece filter part 1) -->
  <g>
    <g fill="none" stroke="#666" stroke-width="3">
      <ellipse cx="260" cy="422" rx="80" ry="10"/>
      <ellipse cx="260" cy="432" rx="80" ry="10"/>
      <ellipse cx="260" cy="442" rx="80" ry="10"/>
    </g>
    <text x="370" y="425" font-size="13" fill="#333">spiral spring</text>
    <line x1="340" y1="428" x2="364" y2="424" stroke="#888" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Mesh screen (part 2) -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="260" cy="500" rx="80" ry="12" fill="#c9c9c9" stroke="#777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="260" cy="500" rx="80" ry="12" fill="url(#mesh)" stroke="#777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="370" y="505" font-size="13" fill="#333">mesh screen</text>
    <line x1="340" y1="502" x2="364" y2="504" stroke="#888" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Cross plate / bottom plate (part 3) -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="260" cy="565" rx="80" ry="12" fill="#888" stroke="#555" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="260" cy="559" rx="80" ry="12" fill="#aaa" stroke="#666" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="246" y="548" width="28" height="10" rx="3" fill="#777"/>
    <text x="370" y="565" font-size="13" fill="#333">cross plate</text>
    <line x1="340" y1="562" x2="364" y2="564" stroke="#888" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Nut at rod end -->
  <g>
    <rect x="248" y="617" width="24" height="14" rx="3" fill="#555"/>
    <text x="120" y="630" font-size="13" fill="#333">retaining nut</text>
    <line x1="246" y1="624" x2="200" y2="628" stroke="#888" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Beaker -->
  <g>
    <path d="M170 700 v110 a10 10 0 0 0 10 10 h160 a10 10 0 0 0 10 -10 v-110" fill="rgba(180,220,240,0.35)" stroke="#4a7a96" stroke-width="3"/>
    <ellipse cx="260" cy="700" rx="90" ry="12" fill="rgba(180,220,240,0.25)" stroke="#4a7a96" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- spout -->
    <path d="M170 700 q-14 -6 -16 -14 q12 2 18 8" fill="rgba(180,220,240,0.35)" stroke="#4a7a96" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <!-- handle -->
    <path d="M350 720 q55 5 55 55 q0 45 -55 45" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- base band -->
    <rect x="168" y="806" width="184" height="16" rx="6" fill="#444"/>
    <text x="80" y="760" font-size="13" fill="#333">glass beaker</text>
    <line x1="168" y1="760" x2="150" y2="760" stroke="#888" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- assembly dashed guide -->
  <line x1="260" y1="55" x2="260" y2="640" stroke="#bbb" stroke-dasharray="2,6"/>

  <defs>
    <pattern id="mesh" width="6" height="6" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M0 0 L6 6 M6 0 L0 6" stroke="#999" stroke-width="0.8"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>
</svg>
